pages.lesson:
LESSON: READING ALOUD

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: READING Theme 3: My Surroundings (My Classroom) Strand Sub Strand Specific Learn
Topic 2.5: Reading aloud
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading aloud, part of READING Theme 3: My Surroundings (My Classroom) Strand Sub Strand Specific Learn in Grade 5 GERMAN.

Key inquiry question: How do we become fluent in a language?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read aloud list of hobbies from flashcards,

2. read sentences on hobbies aloud and match to the appropriate picture,

3. read short sentences/ simple text on hobbies and interests with peers and simulate them,

4. research on popular hobbies in Germany and read them aloud in plenary.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read aloud list of hobbies from flashcards,
2. read sentences on hobbies aloud and match to the appropriate picture,
3. read short sentences/ simple text on hobbies and interests with peers and simulate them,
4. research on popular hobbies in Germany and read them aloud in plenary.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading aloud together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Creativity and imagination: Learner enhances their skills of making connections as they read short sentences/ simple text on

hobbies and interests with peers and simulate them.

Learning to Learn: The learner develops skills of learning on their own as they research on popular hobbies in Germany and

read them aloud in plenary.

Love: Learner enhances their love for various interests and hobbies as they read short sentences/ simple text on hobbies and

interests with peers and simulate them.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

hobbies in Germany and read them aloud in plenary.

Link to other Learning Areas

The learner links the concept of hobbies and interests to the same concept in Creative Arts and Sports.
